discredited-neural-tuner.summary: Once a technician doing shady work deep inside Mordenheim Kinetics, you were punished for reasons you may not even know, escaped the recycling vats, and now haunt the campus edges hunting for the truth about your old employer.

fabricated-mind.summary: A brand-new consciousness born from Mordenheim Kinetics' neurotechnology, you woke with no idea who made you, and you seek a self of your own, kindred minds or revenge.

mutated-commuter.summary: A train wreck on your daily commute left you alive but supernaturally changed, stranded at the isolated Mordenheim Kinetics campus searching for help and answers.

reconstructed-runaway.summary: After your death, your mind was put into an artificial body built in Mordenheim Kinetics' labs, and now you flee the company to avoid paying for the procedure.
